segment.source:
::The man waves you away with his left hand, displaying that two of his fingers - his pinky and his ring finger - are not attached any more.::
Sorry, $(#jack/sister). There ain't no room here if ya came to fish.<end>
segment.target:
::The man waves you away with his left hand, displaying that two of his fingers - his pinky and his ring finger - are not attached any more.::
Sorry, $(#jack/sister). There ain't no room here if ya came to fish.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: What is this place?<end>
segment.target: What is this place?<end>

segment.source: Ya haven't been here before, eh? The place is called Junkyard. It ain't your typical station or nothin' like that. Like South Gate or Rail Crossin'. Nothin' like that.<end>
segment.target: Ya haven't been here before, eh? The place is called Junkyard. It ain't your typical station or nothin' like that. Like South Gate or Rail Crossin'. Nothin' like that.<end>

segment.source: We ain't got no laws, we ain't got no militia, so tread carefully and try not to step on any toes, especially those of Black Eels or Scrappers. They are the two biggest gangs, and between them they control most of the Junkyard. Ya mess with them, ya end up in one of them scrap compactors. Yup.<end>
segment.target: We ain't got no laws, we ain't got no militia, so tread carefully and try not to step on any toes, especially those of Black Eels or Scrappers. They are the two biggest gangs, and between them they control most of the Junkyard. Ya mess with them, ya end up in one of them scrap compactors. Yup.<end>

segment.source: Thanks for the tip. Got any more advice?<end>
segment.target: Thanks for the tip. Got any more advice?<end>

segment.source: ::He shrugs.:: Let people fish in peace.<end>
segment.target: ::He shrugs.:: Let people fish in peace.<end>

segment.source: I'll take care. Thanks for the info.<end>
segment.target: I'll take care. Thanks for the info.<end>

segment.source: ::He nods.:: Yup. Bye.<end>
segment.target: ::He nods.:: Yup. Bye.<end>

segment.source: What are you fishing for?<end>
segment.target: What are you fishing for?<end>

segment.source: Why, eels, of course. They are de-licious and if I catch more than I need, I can always sell the rest to Kareem's Bar. They got eel sandwiches there, and they make 'em pretty good.<end>
segment.target: Why, eels, of course. They are de-licious and if I catch more than I need, I can always sell the rest to Kareem's Bar. They got eel sandwiches there, and they make 'em pretty good.<end>

segment.source: So leave me to my fishin'.<end>
segment.target: So leave me to my fishin'.<end>

segment.source: What happened to your fingers?<end>
segment.target: What happened to your fingers?<end>

segment.source: Ran out of fishin' bait.<end>
segment.target: Ran out of fishin' bait.<end>

segment.source:
::You stare at each other in silence. He is the first to break it.::
Nah. Scavengin' accident. I was at one of them... eh... Biocorp facilities when a security bot shot me. Blew off these two fingers of mine, but nothin' else.<end>
segment.target:

segment.source: Can't say I envy you. Where did that happen? Was it somewhere close?<end>
segment.target: Can't say I envy you. Where did that happen? Was it somewhere close?<end>

segment.source: Nah, that happened somewhere near Core City. Long time ago. Long story.<end>
segment.target: Nah, that happened somewhere near Core City. Long time ago. Long story.<end>

segment.source: Look, can I fish now?<end>
segment.target: Look, can I fish now?<end>

segment.source: At least it wasn't your head.<end>
segment.target: At least it wasn't your head.<end>

segment.source: Nope. ::He laughs.::<end>
segment.target: Nope. ::He laughs.::<end>

segment.source: I'll be going now.<end>
segment.target: I'll be going now.<end>

segment.source: You mentioned Kareem's bar. What can you tell me about it?<end>
segment.target: You mentioned Kareem's bar. What can you tell me about it?<end>

segment.source: It's a bar and the owner's name's Kareem. Yup.<end>
segment.target: It's a bar and the owner's name's Kareem. Yup.<end>

segment.source: Where can I find it?<end>
segment.target: Where can I find it?<end>

segment.source: Eh... ::He points his hand toward the entrance to Junkyard.:: Once you get past the gate go west. The bar is right behind Johan's scrap pile.<end>
segment.target: Eh... ::He points his hand toward the entrance to Junkyard.:: Once you get past the gate go west. The bar is right behind Johan's scrap pile.<end>

segment.source: Johan's scrap pile?<end>
segment.target: Johan's scrap pile?<end>

segment.source: Ya ask a lot of questions. Ya will see for yerself, $(#jack/sister).<end>
segment.target: Ya ask a lot of questions. Ya will see for yerself, $(#jack/sister).<end>

segment.source: Got it. I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: Got it. I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: Eh?<end>
